patthana17.3:1.1: abyākataṃ upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: abyākataṃ upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: abyākataṃ upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na upādinnupādāniyo ca na akusalo na upādinnupādāniyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana17.3:3.1: kusalo anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo na kusalassa na anupādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: .. na akusalassa na anupādinnupādāniyassa.. na akusalassa na anupādinnupādāniyassa ca nakusalassa na anupādinnupādāniyassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana17.3:5.1: kusalaṃ anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
